name: devcrew
description: Unified engineering-OS plugin for Claude Code: a dispatcher-guided workflow with bounded specialist subagents (builders, reviewers, verifiers, architects), quality gates, and inspectable handoff artifacts, layered with a PM-triaged backlog, slice-scoped Given-When-Then specs, parallel-worktree wave dispatch, automated phase-gate quality + review + validation, and decision-grade retrospectives. Stack-agnostic; per-repo config selects test commands at phase boundaries.

ingest_url.title: AstraRunner ingest URL
ingest_url.description: Environment URL to report loop telemetry to (e.g. https://api.astrarunner.com for prod, or your dev/staging URL). Overridable per-run by LOOP_INGEST_URL.

ingest_token.title: AstraRunner ingest token
ingest_token.description: Ingest bearer token (starts with lrt_) minted in the AstraRunner dashboard for your application. Stored in the OS keychain; never written to the repo.

astrarunner_env.title: AstraRunner tier
astrarunner_env.description: Tier label used to route ingest and pick the tokens file: local | staging | prod. Only needed when resolving the URL from ~/.astrarunner/profiles.json instead of ingest_url above.
